source_description_html:
SCHUBERTH is proud to introduce the CONCEPT, a new point of entry into SCHUBERTH ownership. The CONCEPT helmet encapsulates all the essential features riders are looking for in a modular helmet, while delivering the quality and premium construction people have come to expect from SCHUBERTH.

Hand made in Germany, the SCHUBERTH CONCEPT brings the premium helmet experience to a wider audience, with a compelling feature set for riders entering this segment. Crucially, the CONCEPT is the first helmet to achieve ECE-R 22.06 UA (Universal Accessory) homologation. This new certification means that the CONCEPT helmet is the first and only helmet to meet and exceed the ECE-R 22.06's safety requirements with an aftermarket communications system installed. This combined with our dual density EPS, DFP fiberglass shell, Class 1 optics, and AROS System ensures that riders can be confident that they are riding in a state-of-the-art safety product.

  • DOT FMVSS No. 218
  • EPS and helmet trim prepared for the installation of aftermarket communication systems.
  • Fiberglass shell for improved shock absorption strength and lighter weight
  • New chin strap positioning to improve comfort in the throat area featuring Anti Roll Off System ( A.R.O.S)
  • Aerodynamically and aeroacoustically optimized in the property wind tunnel for a low noise level.
  • Improved ventilation through multichannel ventilation with insect protection
  • Integrated drop-down sun visor featuring the SCHUBERTH V-lock sun visor mechanism
  • New patented visor mechanism featuring Memory Function
  • Preinstalled Pinlock® 70
  • Reflective Area on the Wind deflector, neck roll, visor sealing and helmet stickers for enhanced visibility while riding with open and close chin bar
